searchText: Hey there, I have a question about https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Node/getPeers. What is the expected outcome for the following examples: 1. `state: [disconnected, foo]` 2. `state: [foo, bar]` Should we just ignore unknown values or would a 400 response be better? The spec does not include a 400 response example. I would like to make sure it's intentional. I would _suggest_ that the unknown state values are quietly ignored, but the filter still applied. So in case 1) return any peers that are disconnected, and in case 2 return no peers. If others agree with this I can update the docs accordingly. I am going to follow your suggestion for now and keep track of the channel to see whether something else is desired. thanks for the reply
